svg.title: The Charter: Engrossed deed with wax seal
svg.desc: The Charter (1D): a deed of sale laid on a writing slope. The player has followed the clause references (the red thread) to the binding clause, "and all waters adjoining", pinned and underlined it, and is dragging the evidence slip from the drawer onto it. Three ink drops show the guesses left; the ribboned wax seal waits at the foot of the deed.
